menu.name: MENU
menu.title: Module menu
menu.description: The on-radio list that opens when you hold Back. Installed automatically with the first app.

apps.name: BRICK BREAKER
apps.title: Brick Breaker
apps.description: Break 30 bricks with a bouncing ball. Menu moves the paddle left, Back moves it right, Up restarts after GAME OVER. Power-cycle to leave.

apps.name: APRS
apps.title: APRS
apps.description: Onboard APRS client: station list (opens with the stock Beacon List), station details, a map around your GPS position, messages (yours in green), and sending canned test packets and messages from your callsign (experimental; stock firmware does the transmitting). Hold Menu to switch screens, Back to go back. Each screen loads into RAM when you open it.

apps.name: APRS MONITOR
apps.title: APRS Monitor (probe)
apps.description: First step to an onboard APRS client: reads packets and GPS straight from the APRS modem's serial ring and shows the last four stations heard. Also tests whether the ring keeps filling while an app runs. Receive only. Back returns to the menu.
